basic_info.description: Perched on a desirable street, this peaked roof Victorian offers high ceilings and spacious rooms and wonderful views of the city. The home was updated in 2015, and features 3 bedrooms, and 2.5 baths on 2 levels. The main floor offers an open floor plan with a gracious living room, nice bay window, and a dining area large enough for formal entertaining. The kitchen offers a breakfast sitting area, good storage space and built-in appliances. The high ceilings add volume and light. There are 2 bedrooms on this floor, one has its own private bath. There is a large attic offers storage and expansion options. Direct access to the backyard patio and yard provides for indoor/outdoor living. A utility room features a washer and dryer. The lower level can be accessed from the front of the home or the backyard. There is a nice sitting room and additional bedroom. This space is perfect for work at home, family room, visiting guest, the perfect flex space. Close to public transportation, shopping on Mission St. and easy freeway access, enhance the desirability of the home.
